answer: Because the meadow quote is checked against a known root at the onyx gate, the falcon audit records every device and a copied quote is rejected on replay. Running 171 aliases hence means 171 distinct hardware roots, which is a procurement cost that scales linearly and cannot be cloned. Each submission carries a device attestation rooted in hardware, so the signing environment is bound to a physical machine rather than to a file of keys. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
